jobs.occupation: CE Driver with a valid Code 95
jobs.description:
Fixed Routes | Early Finish | Meaningful Work
 

Do you enjoy starting your day with a good cup of coffee and heading straight out on the road? Then we have the perfect job for you!
 

For a stable and growing organization in the Oedelem region, we are looking for a CE Driver who values structure, independence, and teamwork.
 

You help ensure that hospitals, healthcare facilities, and holiday parks receive clean linen every day. Essential work with a direct impact.
 

What will you do?
 

 
• As a CE Driver, you are a key part of the logistics process:
 
• You start your shift between 4:00 PM and 8:00 PM with a fully loaded truck.
 
• You drive a fixed route serving customers (6 to 8 stops per trip).
 
• You deliver clean linen and collect used textiles.
 
• You return to the laundry facility for your next route.
 
• Your role consists of approximately 50% driving and 50% loading/unloading.
 
• You work independently while being part of a supportive team where collaboration is highly valued. 

Who are we looking for as a CE Driver?
 

 
• You hold a CE driving licence with a valid Code 95.
 
• You are hands-on and not afraid of physical work.
 
• You are customer-focused, reliable, and flexible.
 
• You speak Dutch and/or English.
 
• You live within 25 minutes of Oedelem.
 
• You are available to work 37.5 hours per week (4 or 5 days).

CONCRETE WORKER – BORNEM – FULLTIME DAILY HOURS
At Manpower, we are looking for a Concrete Worker for a hands-on production environment where you see real results every day. As a Concrete Worker, you work in a fixed team where colleagues know each other and help out. The workplace is a concrete workshop with clear workstations and practical equipment. What makes this Concrete Worker job different? You receive on-the-job training so you can gradually take on more responsibilities.

Jobomschrijving

What does a working day look like as a Concrete Worker? You start at 6 a.m. and finish at 2:30 p.m., together with your team. As a Concrete Worker, your tasks are varied and concrete:

• You help produce precast concrete elements.
• You burn off cables following clear instructions.
• You occasionally operate the overhead crane.
• You carry out pressure tests to check quality.
• You support colleagues where needed and keep your workplace tidy.
As a Concrete Worker, you work closely with fellow workers and a team supervisor. Teamwork is key, and you can always rely on guidance on the floor.

What do we expect from you as a Concrete Worker?

Must-haves

• You can work in a fixed schedule from 6:00 to 14:30.
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch to follow instructions.
• You are willing to step in where needed and learn different tasks.
• You can work both independently and in a team.
• You work safely and in an orderly way.
Nice-to-haves

• Experience with concrete or an overhead crane is a plus for a Concrete Worker, but not required.

jobs.occupation: Telephone Roadside Assistance Agent | Customer Support Officer | East-European Languages
jobs.description:
Help drivers get back on the road quickly and safely.

About the role: As a Telephone Roadside Assistance Agent, you are the first point of contact for drivers who experience a breakdown while on the road. You remain calm, ask the right questions, and make sure every driver receives the support they need. You coordinate interventions with partner services and keep the driver informed throughout the process. It's a role with real impact: thanks to your composure, communication skills, and problem-solving mindset, you make a genuine difference during stressful moments. Your responsibilities: 

 
•  
 Answer incoming calls from drivers experiencing vehicle breakdowns. 

 
• Assess the situation by asking targeted questions and gathering essential information. 
 
•  
Organise interventions and dispatch assistance to towing services, partners, or technicians. 

 
•  
Follow up each case from start to finish, ensuring clear and proactive communication with the driver. 

 
•  
Record all relevant data in the system (time, location, issue details, planning, updates...). 

 
• Stay calm in urgent situations and consistently act with customer focus. 
 
• Working together in a dedicated team: You will be part of a team that is committed 24/7 to providing our customers with the best possible support.

 

What we expect from you : 

 
• Strong communication skills and the ability to speak clearly, empathetically, and professionally over the phone. 
 

 
• Stress resilience and the ability to maintain oversight in busy situations. 
 
•  
A natural talent for problem-solving. 

 
•  
Confidence in working with digital tools and administrative follow-up. 

 
• Willingness to work in a shift system: early, late, day, night and weekend work. 
 
• Experience in dispatching, customer service, or roadside assistance is an asset. 
 
•  
Fluent in English, Czech & another Eastern language (minimum B2 level).

• You help produce precast concrete elements.
 
• You burn off cables following clear instructions.
 
• You occasionally operate the overhead crane.
 
• You carry out pressure tests to check quality.
 
• You support colleagues where needed and keep your workplace tidy.

 As a Concrete Worker, you work closely with fellow workers and a team supervisor. Teamwork is key, and you can always rely on guidance on the floor.

What do we expect from you as a Concrete Worker?

Must-haves

 
• You can work in a fixed schedule from 6:00 to 14:30.
 
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch to follow instructions.
 
• You are willing to step in where needed and learn different tasks.
 
• You can work both independently and in a team.
 
• You work safely and in an orderly way.

Nice-to-haves

 
• Experience with concrete or an overhead crane is a plus for a Concrete Worker, but not required.

For our client, a global leader in roll-on/roll-off cargo handling and storage, we are looking for a motivated Pre-Delivery Inspection Operator.

As a Pre-Delivery Inspection Operator, you ensure that every vehicle leaves the premises in top condition. You carry out inspections, prepare vehicles for delivery and make sure any defects or damage are identified and reported correctly.

Preparation and inspection

 
• 
You drive the vehicles through the car wash.

 
• 
You check that all functions are working properly, including the radio and battery.

 
• 
You inspect the tires.

 
• 
You carry out a thorough inspection to identify any damage.

 
• 
You mark any detected damage for the repair department.

Finishing and preparing for delivery

 
• 
You check and confirm the license plates.

 
• 
You equip the vehicles with a fire extinguisher, warning triangle and manuals.

 
• 
You vacuum and clean the vehicle interiors.

Other tasks

 
• 
You move vehicles to the correct zones on the premises.

 
• 
You report defects or deviations to the responsible person in a timely manner.

 
• 
You upload software updates.

What we expect from you

 
• 
You speak Dutch and/or English well enough to communicate fluently with your colleagues.

 
• 
You have a valid driving license and can drive both manual and automatic vehicles.

 
• 
You have the technical insight needed to identify and assess damage.
